141K likes, 1,084 comments - fentybeauty on August 19, 2026: "Made to move with every (e)motion ✨

Meet our NEW foundation, Pro Filt’r Fluid Flex. Designed to bend, stretch + stay smooth through smiles, tears, sweat + everything in between. 💫 It delivers lightweight, medium buildable coverage with a natural matte finish that looks like skin, feels like nothing, and stays color-true for up to 12 hours. Available in 50 shades with even more neutral undertones, so finding your Fenty fit is easier than ever.

Launching globally 9/4.".
